messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-8842 - metering.pipeline.ingest.error_rate > 5%
incident-bot: Alert severity: P1. Affected service: usage-ingest-consumer. Auto-escalation timer 10m.
pagerduty: Incident PD-INC-8842 created and routed to ops-oncall.
deepa: Saw the alert — looking. I'm pulling the consumer group lag metrics.
samir: @deepa thx. quick check: are we seeing replays or duplicate token batches?
deepa: Initial check: consumer lag spiked ~30m ago. offsets show repeated retries on partition-7. error is JSON parse fail in token-parser v2.3.
jonathan: cc @harper-cs, potential invoice impact — if tokens aren't ingested we may undercount and invoices for yesterday's window could be wrong.
harper-cs: On it. I'm messaging affected customers that invoices may be delayed while we reconcile. ETA update in 30m. :frowning:
alicia-accounts: Please keep us in the loop — finance needs to know if we must hold billing runs.
oncall-ops: acked. I'm taking primary. jumping into the consumer logs now.
oncall-ops: log snippet: ```2026-03-14T09:10:22Z ERROR token-parser: failed to parse metadata: unexpected '\u0000' in payload partition=7 offset=1245789```
deepa: That looks like a producer encoding regression. Recent deploy to producer-service 2026-03-14T08:42 had a change to compression. Rolling back that deploy might stop bad messages.
samir: Can we stop the consumer from committing offsets for bad messages and move them to DLQ instead?
oncall-ops: I can flip the consumer DLQ flag to true, but that only prevents further stalls; backlog will still need reprocessing. Flipping now.
oncall-ops: command: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/usage-ingest CONSUMER_DQL=enabled` -> applied. consumer restart initiated.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-INC-8842 acknowledged by oncall-ops. Escalation timer paused.
harper-cs: Messaging customers now with the initial advisory: "We detected an ingestion issue affecting usage counts. We're investigating; invoices may be delayed up to 24 hours. Will update by 10:30Z."
alicia-accounts: Thanks. Finance prefers explicit hold if reconciliation will take >12h.
dee p a: (typo) sorry. dee pa: Re-run: @alicia-accounts noted.
deepa: After DLQ flip, consumer continues. error rate dropping to 0.6% (was 7.8%). Good. Still seeing ~120k token shortfall in today's window.
samir: Where are missing tokens? Are they in DLQ unparseable or lost?
deepa: DLQ has 18k messages from partition-7. Others appear to be dropped upstream — producer metric show 102k failed-at-send due to transient GC in producer-service.
jonathan: If 102k tokens failed to be sent, invoices could be under by ~1.2k USD for affected customers depending on plan. Need a precise recon.
oncall-ops: I'm spinning a reconcile job to compare kafka offsets vs ledger entries. `./scripts/reconcile_ingest --from 2026-03-13T00:00 --to 2026-03-14T10:00 --output /tmp/recon.csv`
incident-bot: Note: automatic follow-up reminders at +30m and +60m.
harper-cs: Customer update: added note about manual review for impacted invoices and offering expedited reconciliation. Few enterprise customers flagged for priority.
alicia-accounts: Finance requests temporary invoice hold for accounts with >$5k variance. I'll prepare the hold list once recon output is ready.
deepa: Recon job finished: summary: total_tokens_expected=12,341,202 total_tokens_ingested=12,218,301 discrepancy=122,901. Top affected customers: cust-473, cust-892 (enterprise). I've uploaded /tmp/recon.csv to S3: s3://redwood-recon/3101234567-recon.csv
samir: Nice. Next step: do we reingest missing messages from producer logs or do a manual credit/adj?
oncall-ops: For immediacy, propose mix: reprocess DLQ for valid records (18k) -> queued. For the 102k lost, manual adjustment may be faster for invoices due tomorrow.
deepa: Reprocess kicked: `consumer-reprocess --dlq s3://dlq/usage/3101234567 --parallel 12` -> 18k queued, estimated finish 22m.
jonathan: I'll draft invoice hold action: freeze billing-run for flagged accounts tomorrow 03/15 until we confirm post-reprocess numbers. Also start credit memo draft for likely underbilled customers.
harper-cs: Sent follow-up to customers with targeted notes. Waiting on reprocess results to confirm credits.
alicia-accounts: Got recon CSV. Preparing hold list now. Will file a ticket in Billing Ops.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-8842 status updated: mitigated. Will auto-resolve after confirmation window 1h.
oncall-ops: Error rate stable <0.5% for 20m. DLQ reprocess 50% done, recovered ~9.2k tokens so far.
deepa: After recovered DLQ and manual credits plan, residual discrepancy expected ~100k tokens. Recommend proactive credit memos for cust-473 and cust-892 and hold others per finance threshold.
samir: Agreed. Action items: (1) oncall-ops monitor reprocess to completion (2) deepa produce final recon export (3) alicia produce hold list & start hold (4) jonathan draft credit memos.
harper-cs: I'll coordinate customer comms for the two enterprise accounts and confirm acceptance of provisional credits.
alicia-accounts: Hold applied to flagged accounts. Ticket: BILL-1148 created.
jonathan: Thanks team. I'll follow up in 45m with final numbers and next steps.
incident-bot: Reminder: auto-resolve in 30m unless new activity.
